summary: Reproduced the reported DCP planner TypeError in the checked-out implementation. Added a DCP-local target-verify normalization that derives committed prefix lengths, fixed verify-block lengths, and total sequence lengths before calling the planner, without changing metadata consumed by other target-verify attention backends.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-d935b77a7f3f/venv/bin/python (direct prepare_decode_context_parallel_metadata call with target-verify None fields; see reproduction_before.txt)
tests.what_was_measured: The actual checked-out planner failed at planner.py:64 with TypeError from torch.cumsum(extend_prefix_lens=None), matching the source issue failure point.

Five regression/boundary cases passed: DSpark's expanded CPU mirror uses committed live lengths, fixed verify geometry is derived on CPU and gfx950, absent live lengths use the ForwardBatch CPU mirror, absent CPU mirrors fall back to device lengths, and ordinary extend metadata is unchanged.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-d935b77a7f3f/venv/bin/python (gfx950 DCP planner validation with indexing kernels mocked; see gpu_validation.txt)
tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950, the corrected handoff produced prefix=[11,23], extend=[7,7], total=[18,30] and the actual planner constructed a [48,1] DCP KV buffer instead of reaching cumsum(None).
All configured formatting, lint, source, and registered-test checks passed.

remaining_limitations: The reported Kimi K3 model weights were not available.

The original topology requires separate prefill/decode nodes and eight B300 GPUs per side; this job provided one gfx950 GPU, so no full-model, Mooncake, eight-rank, or multi-node reproduction is claimed.

GPU planner validation mocked the two indexing kernels to isolate sequence-geometry handling; it validates the reported failure point and metadata construction, not distributed KV-transfer correctness or model semantic accuracy.
